title: Ask
question: Your learning question
warning: Do not type personal or financial details. Do not include account numbers, balances, passwords or identity documents.
disclosure: Questions without a keyword match go through this app's server to Groq, with your selected language, to find and explain relevant learning entries.
retention: The app does not log or save questions. The host and Groq have their own data policies. Conversation history is not sent.
consent: I understand this disclosure and want to send a general learning question.
refusal: I do not give investment advice or judge market calls. Outcomes depend on uncertain prices and personal needs. I can explain risk, leverage and fraud checks.
unknown: I couldn’t connect that question to a learning topic yet. Could you tell me which term or part of the practice you mean?
greeting: Hi! What would you like to understand? Ask me about this practice, leverage, recovery maths or spotting scams.
thanks: No problem! If a term or part of the practice feels unclear, ask me and we can go through it.
goodbye: Take care! You can reopen chat whenever you want to keep learning.
help: I can explain this practice and general learning topics. What would you like to understand—leverage, recovery maths, risk or scam warning signs?
private: Do not send personal or financial details. Please ask a general question without private information.
limited: Chat is busy or the request limit is reached. Wait before asking again. You can read related learning entries.
disabled: Chat is switched off. The practice journey still works.
unavailable: I couldn’t complete that explanation just now. Please try again shortly, or ask about a specific term in this practice.
loadError: The learning library is unavailable. Reconnect and reopen chat. The practice journey can still continue.

about: Greetings and keyword matches are answered on this device. Other questions and language go through the app server to Groq; practice answers stay local.
vendor: Groq may retain data under its service policy. Do not assume that provider retention is disabled. The AI can be wrong.
